### Points to confirm at review

- **Goal priorities were inferred, not asked.** No release brief existed, so I did not pause the demo to ask. All 5 statement-of-work objectives have in-scope deliverables, so all 5 are marked Primary. The document says this and asks for confirmation at review.
- **OQ-3 (cancellation reasons) still blocks the build.** The calls proposed 3 top-level reasons (price, delivery, drinking too little), with the 14 customer success reasons as sub-tags. Cathy Marsh only gave support through Steph, so this is recorded as proposed, not agreed.
- **OQ-7 (market scope) is resolved.** Becky confirmed all 4 markets, tagged by country code, with UK and Ireland combined for finance.
- **Still open:** OQ-1 (guest checkouts), OQ-2 (Shopify or Stripe wins on subscription state), OQ-4 (how GA4 joins to Stripe), OQ-5 (wholesale orders), OQ-8 (Klaviyo event types), OQ-9 (pause versus cancel).
